column1: # kinds.tsv -- dish words -> food kind + traits (module_dining v1 rulebook).
# Read by venue_facts.py. A venue's KIND set = its place-page category word
# plus every word below found in its representative (repr) menu names; two
# cards whose kind sets meet are the same kind of food (the 10-15 round sent
# two shabu places, one of them labelled "korean" by its category).
# Traits are read over the WHOLE menu and only reported (menu_flags), with the
# item names as evidence; the agent states them in the fit line. Nothing here
# excludes a venue by itself (taste store = later, the framework maintainer Why-net seam).
# Format: <word> TAB <kind> TAB <traits, comma list or -> TAB <display>
#   kind     ascii token; generic = a category word that says too little
#            (the card header then adds the repr kinds)
#   traits   spicy | very_spicy | chicken | western | fried | greasy |
#            raw_fish | single (one serving per person as listed) | broth |
#            category (matched against the place category ONLY: "yangsik"
#            in a menu means "farmed fish", in "boyangsik" it is a tonic)
#   display  owner-facing word for the header ('-' = the word itself)
